import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MAXN = 25;
    static final int INF = 10007;
    static final int MAXT = 65;
    static final int MAXC = 12;
    
    static int n, k;
    static String[] T1 = new String[MAXN];
    static String[] T2 = new String[MAXN];
    static int[][] distZ = new int[MAXN][MAXN];
    static int[][][][][] memo = new int[MAXT][MAXC][MAXC][MAXC][MAXC];
    static int[] dirX = {1, 0, -1, 0};
    static int[] dirY = {0, 1, 0, -1};
    static List<int[]> sources = new ArrayList<>();
    static List<int[]> sinks = new ArrayList<>();
    
    static class RelabelFlow {
        static class Edge {
            int from, to, cap, flow;
            Edge(int from, int to, int cap) {
                this.from = from;
                this.to = to;
                this.cap = cap;
                this.flow = 0;
            }
        }
        int N;
        List<Edge> edges = new ArrayList<>();
        List<List<Integer>> adj;
        int[] h, inQ, cnt;
        int[] ex;
        Queue<Integer> q;
        
        RelabelFlow(int N) {
            this.N = N;
            adj = new ArrayList<>(N);
            for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) adj.add(new ArrayList<>());
            h = new int[N];
            inQ = new int[N];
            cnt = new int[N << 1];
            ex = new int[N];
            q = new LinkedList<>();
        }
        
        int addEdge(int u, int v, int cap) {
            adj.get(u).add(edges.size());
            edges.add(new Edge(u, v, cap));
            adj.get(v).add(edges.size());
            edges.add(new Edge(v, u, 0));
            return adj.get(u).get(adj.get(u).size() - 1);
        }
        
        void enQueue(int u) {
            if (inQ[u] == 0 && ex[u] > 0) {
                q.add(u);
                inQ[u] = 1;
            }
        }
        
        void pushEdge(int id) {
            Edge e = edges.get(id);
            int d = Math.min(e.cap - e.flow, ex[e.from]);
            if (d > 0 && h[e.from] > h[e.to]) {
                e.flow += d;
                ex[e.to] += d;
                ex[e.from] -= d;
                edges.get(id ^ 1).flow -= d;
                enQueue(e.to);
            }
        }
        
        void relabelNode(int u) {
            cnt[h[u]]--;
            h[u] = 2 * N - 2;
            for (int i = 0; i < adj.get(u).size(); ++i) {
                Edge e = edges.get(adj.get(u).get(i));
                if (e.cap > e.flow) h[u] = Math.min(h[u], h[e.to]);
            }
            cnt[++h[u]]++;
        }
        
        void gap(int height) {
            for (int u = 0; u < N; ++u) {
                if (h[u] >= height && h[u] < N) {
                    cnt[h[u]]--;
                    h[u] = N;
                    cnt[N]++;
                    enQueue(u);
                }
            }
        }
        
        void discharge(int u) {
            for (int i = 0; ex[u] > 0 && i < adj.get(u).size(); ++i) {
                pushEdge(adj.get(u).get(i));
            }
            if (ex[u] > 0) {
                if (h[u] < N && cnt[h[u]] < 2) gap(h[u]);
                else relabelNode(u);
            } else if (!q.isEmpty()) {
                q.poll();
                inQ[u] = 0;
            }
        }
        
        int maxflow(int s, int t) {
            h[s] = N;
            inQ[s] = inQ[t] = 1;
            cnt[0] = N - (cnt[N] = 1);
            for (int i = 0; i < adj.get(s).size(); ++i) {
                ex[s] += edges.get(adj.get(s).get(i)).cap;
                pushEdge(adj.get(s).get(i));
            }
            while (!q.isEmpty()) discharge(q.peek());
            return ex[t];
        }
    }
    
    static void computeDist(int sx, int sy) {
        for (int[] row : distZ) Arrays.fill(row, -1);
        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        distZ[sx][sy] = 0;
        q.add(new int[]{sx, sy});
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cur = q.poll();
            int x = cur[0], y = cur[1];
            for (int d = 0; d < 4; ++d) {
                int nx = x + dirX[d];
                int ny = y + dirY[d];
                if (nx < 0 || nx >= n || ny < 0 || ny >= n) continue;
                if (distZ[nx][ny] != -1) continue;
                if (T2[nx].charAt(ny) == 'Y' || T2[nx].charAt(ny) == 'Z') continue;
                distZ[nx][ny] = distZ[x][y] + 1;
                q.add(new int[]{nx, ny});
            }
        }
    }
    
    static int can(int t, int x0, int y0, int x, int y) {
        if (distZ[x0][y0] < t) return 0;
        if (x0 == x && y0 == y) return 1;
        if (t >= k) return 0;
        if (distZ[x0][y0] <= t) return 0;
        if (memo[t][x0][y0][x][y] != -1) return memo[t][x0][y0][x][y];
        for (int d = 0; d < 4; ++d) {
            int nx = x0 + dirX[d];
            int ny = y0 + dirY[d];
            if (nx < 0 || nx >= n || ny < 0 || ny >= n) continue;
            if (T1[nx].charAt(ny) == 'Y' || T1[nx].charAt(ny) == 'Z') continue;
            if (can(t + 1, nx, ny, x, y) == 1) {
                memo[t][x0][y0][x][y] = 1;
                return 1;
            }
        }
        memo[t][x0][y0][x][y] = 0;
        return 0;
    }
    
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        for (int[][][][] a : memo) for (int[][][] b : a) for (int[][] c : b) for (int[] d : c) Arrays.fill(d, -1);
        
        n = sc.nextInt();
        k = sc.nextInt();
        sc.nextLine();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) T1[i] = sc.nextLine();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) T2[i] = sc.nextLine();
        
        int zx = -1, zy = -1;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i)
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j)
                if (T2[i].charAt(j) == 'Z') { zx = i; zy = j; }
        
        computeDist(zx, zy);
        
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i)
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j)
                if (distZ[i][j] == -1) distZ[i][j] = INF;
        
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i)
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                char c = T1[i].charAt(j);
                if (c != 'Z' && c != 'Y' && c != '0') sources.add(new int[]{i, j});
            }
        
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i)
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                char c = T2[i].charAt(j);
                if (c != 'Z' && c != 'Y' && c != '0') sinks.add(new int[]{i, j});
            }
        
        int S = 0;
        int T = sources.size() + sinks.size() + 1;
        RelabelFlow rf = new RelabelFlow(T + 1);
        
        for (int i = 0; i < sources.size(); ++i)
            rf.addEdge(S, i + 1, T1[sources.get(i)[0]].charAt(sources.get(i)[1]) - '0');
        
        for (int i = 0; i < sinks.size(); ++i)
            rf.addEdge(sources.size() + i + 1, T,
                       T2[sinks.get(i)[0]].charAt(sinks.get(i)[1]) - '0');
        
        for (int i = 0; i < sources.size(); ++i)
            for (int j = 0; j < sinks.size(); ++j)
                if (can(0, sources.get(i)[0], sources.get(i)[1],
                        sinks.get(j)[0], sinks.get(j)[1]) == 1)
                    rf.addEdge(i + 1, sources.size() + j + 1, INF);
        
        System.out.println(rf.maxflow(S, T));
    }
}
